correctness.rationale: Verified associativity by the triangle inequality and equality in total metric length. For vertex idempotents e_i, h=Σδ(e_i)e_i gives [h,e_i]=δ(e_i); subtract to normalize. The one-dimensional corners give scalar derivations, whose only equations are additivity along geodesic compositions. Inner derivations preserving the normalization are exactly diagonal potentials, acting on oriented edge scalars by gradients. For odd n all ordered geodesics are unique; after gradients are removed a class is determined by its reciprocal edge sums s_i=a_i+b_i and clockwise circulation A=Σa_i (the sum-zero clockwise vector is a gradient). Every pair (s,A) can be realized. Rotation permutes s and leaves A fixed; reflection acts by (s,A)↦(r s,Σs_i−A). This proves the sign kernel. The section A=(Σs_i)/2 works whenever 2 is invertible, even if the characteristic divides n. In characteristic two, an edge-fixed unit vector has no reflection-fixed lift: every lift changes its circulation by one under that reflection. For even n=2m the only ambiguity is equality of the two sums to each antipode. Subtracting consecutive equations R_x=0 yields s_{x+m}=s_x; the remaining equation is A=Σ_{i=m}^{2m−1}s_i. Thus every antipodally constant s is reached, and s=0 forces a gradient, proving the natural equivariant isomorphism without any division. The dimensions follow, and the Lie bracket vanishes because the normalized representatives are diagonal. The proof includes n=3 and n=4 and does not use the finite sample to infer any characteristic or length.
residual_risks: Concerns the stated distance algebra and HH¹, not graph magnitude cohomology or higher Hochschild groups. The recorded finite tests corroborate, not replace, the all-length proof.

value.rationale: Computes a natural all-size symmetry invariant of the shortest-path algebra on a canonical graph family. The parity contrast identifies different edge modules, while the absence of a reflection-equivariant lift in characteristic two is real representation-theoretic content invisible to ordinary dimensions or a zero bracket. It is useful even though the general framework for outer derivations is established.
residual_risks: No implication for arbitrary graph symmetry modules, higher degrees, or a general classification of algebra deformations is claimed.
